interpretation: The exact known scanner inverse recovers the simulated layer-density correlation to sampling error, while direct scanner RGB is strongly confounded and a plausible wrong scanner inverse remains materially wrong.

P4CQ archival RGB correlation cannot identify dye-layer coupling without an independently bound scanner response. Future real correlation work must first prove scanner profile identity and sufficient calibration accuracy.

claim_ceiling: Controlled float64 simulator evidence about correlation-domain identifiability under a known invertible scanner matrix; not measured dye-layer correlation, scanner calibration, photographic quality or product evidence.
